name: Gaelic Gold

features.name: xNudge Wild
features.description: Three-row wilds that gain +1 per nudge.

features.name: Rainbow Spins
features.description: Triggered by a Pot of Gold in the centre.

review:
A compact 3x3 Irish game, and a tidy introduction to how xNudge works. A three-row xNudge wild can land on any reel and always nudges into view, +1 per nudge, and several wilds in one win add together.

A Pot of Gold in the centre spot starts Rainbow Spins – five to begin with, with chances to extend. Medium volatility, but a 9,837x max is a lot for such a small grid.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
